howto: Press Play, then tap anywhere (or press Space) to throw a knife into the spinning log.
Never hit a knife that is already stuck in the log.
Land every knife to split the log and move to a faster level. Golden apples are worth +5.
tips: Watch the bottom of the log: throw just after a stuck knife passes.
The log can change direction between levels, so check which way it spins.
A level cleared without slicing an apple counts as a Perfect Level.
Throwing quickly in a row builds a Flow streak.
Reach levels 3, 6, 9 and 12 to collect emblems.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow throws. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: each level the log spins faster, has more sections and may reverse direction.

cheats.effect: Slow log: every log spins at half speed
Ghost blade: knives slip past stuck knives
Apple rain: a new golden apple after every slice

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first tap throws and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Clash card starts a new run at once
features.best-score-badge: Best pill in the top bar during play, and on the Clash card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run also explains stuck knives and apples
features.results: Clash card with score, best and emblems
